answer: Cross-epoch behavior consistency gate. Each identity submits a per-epoch action vector checked against its trailing median. Divergence beyond a threshold freezes rewards and caps throughput next epoch. A profile can harbor only one stable pattern, penalizing abrupt role changes. Treat each identity as a knoll that must remain recognizable across epochs. The trailing window acts as a river carrying prior evidence forward. Attackers pay k epochs onboarding latency plus sustained per-profile transaction and monitoring costs; each sybil needs separate history.
